title: Protocol for Measurement of Oxygen Consumption Rate In Situ in Permeabilized Cardiomyocytes
protocol: Turn on the Mitocell respirometry system.
Check the connection between the 782 Oxygen system software and the oxygen meter.
Fill the chamber with MilliQ water using a rinse bottle.
Discard the water from the chamber with a vacuum pump.
Repeat the rinsing process two more times.
Insert the tip of the vacuum pump against the wall of the oxygen electrode chamber to suck out the solution.
Fill air-saturated water into the oxygen electrode chamber.
Put a micro-magnetic stirrer into the oxygen electrode chamber using a plastic forceps.
Start stirring the solution.
Click on “Calibration high” to start calibrating the high value of the electrode.
Wait until the calibration process is completed.
Add a small amount (3–5 mg) of sodium sulfite into the air-saturated water in the oxygen electrode chamber.
Click on “Calibration zero” to calibrate the zero value of the electrode.
Rinse the chamber 6–10 times to wash out the sodium sulfite.
Wash cardiomyocytes twice with 5 mL PBS.
Detach cells using 1 mL 0.05% trypsin for 2–3 minutes.
Pipette the solution 5–8 times.
Collect cardiomyocytes through centrifugation at 80 g for 2 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 1–2 mL mitochondrial respiration medium B (MRB).
Pipette the cells well and use one drop to count the number of cells with an automatic cell counter.
Dilute the counted cells to 5 × 10^5 cells per mL with MRB and keep on ice.
Add 100 μL of the diluted cell suspension (5 × 10^4 cells) using a pipette to oxygen electrode chambers.
Close the oxygen electrode chamber with a transparent polycarbonate plunger, equilibrate for 3–5 minutes.
Start recording oxygen consumption.
After 2–3 minutes of basal line recording, add 5 μL saponin (final concentration ∼50 μg/mL) using a 25 μL microsyringe for cell membrane permeabilization.
Continue recording.
Optimize permeabilization conditions for different cell types to preserve mitochondrial intactness.
Add 5 μL Glutamate/Malate solution (final concentration is ∼10 mM glutamate, ∼5 mM malate) to the chamber and record 2 min of resting complex I-supported respiration.
Incubate with 5 μL 20 mM ADP (final concentration is ∼1 mM) for 3-5 min and record the respiration.
Add 5 μL of 100 μM Oligomycin A (final concentration ∼ 5 μM) to the chamber.
Incubate for 2–3 min and record respiration.
Add 5 μL of 20 μM FCCP (final concentration ∼ 1 μM) to the chamber.
Record respiration until it reaches zero.
Rinse the chamber with MilliQ H2O several times after each experiment.
Sterilize the chamber with 70% ethanol for 30 min.
